title: Trait Forge — Shard-powered permanent upgrade shop
description: New shop state ('traitforge') accessible from home screen. 6 traits purchasable with SHARDS: HARDENED (start +1 life, 30s, max1), RELIC VAULT (unlock 3rd relic slot, 60s, max1), WIDER DRAW (4 pit stop choices, 40s, max1), ECHO SHARDS (earn 30% more shards, 25s, max2), COMBO ARMOR (combo 8+ auto-shields, 35s, max1), OMEN SIGHT (reroll omen once per run, 50s, max1). Store trait ownership in save.traits object. UI: same panel style as BITS shop but with shard currency. Add 'FORGE' button to home screen. Apply traits throughout gameplay.
